title: PAR-134 standalone MTEXT background CMC retention
scope: Preserve standalone MTEXT background CMC truecolor, color-name, and color-book data on DWG parse/write
Share validated method selection between standalone and embedded MTEXT DWG writers
Verify independent CMC field order, detached string placement, parser round-trip, and refusal before output when metadata cannot be represented

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §20.4.46 defines the R2004+ MTEXT background color as CMC, present when the background flags require the payload; §2.11 defines CMC RGB and optional name/book strings. The §20.4.46 table labels background scale as BL but gives default 1.5, an internal inconsistency with the current sample-compatible BitDouble path. This slice does not change that adjacent field; it remains a sample-trace follow-up.

localSource.finding: Standalone MTEXT parsing previously retained only the CMC scalar and its writer emitted only that scalar, losing parsed RGB/name/book fields already present in the public model. The standalone writer now emits validated C0/C1/C2/C3 forms and detached names/books; the parser retains RGB and combines the optional book/name in the existing field. Embedded and standalone MTEXT share the same CMC preparation/output path. The embedded text-frame bit gate now matches the parser's AC1032 version gate.
localSource.compatibility: No public class layout or virtual interface changed.

generatedControls.finding: Independent wire walks cover named C0 ByLayer, named C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, and named black C2 RGB; verify text/name stream order and following transparency; production parse checks retained values and the following-handle sentinel. A second local round trip is checked. Invalid RGB and R2007+ named output without a distinct string stream are refused before the common entity prefix.
generatedControls.limit: Generated vectors establish local codec consistency only; they are not producer-authored or native-consumer evidence.

productionSummary: Capture standalone MTEXT background RGB and optional CMC color/book names during bounded parsing.
Write the full supported CMC state instead of reducing standalone MTEXT background to an indexed scalar.
Use the same method selection and detached-string preflight in standalone and embedded MTEXT writers.
Keep the R2018-only background text-frame flag gate aligned between embedded writer and parser.

unresolved: ODA §20.4.46's background-scale BL label conflicts with its stated 1.5 default and current BitDouble behavior; resolve with a bounded trace from an existing eligible producer sample before changing that field.
Standalone MTEXT CMC source-method identity beyond the supported normalized C0/C1/C2/C3 model, including C5 and internal-only methods, remains a separate audit item.
